data.narrative:
Skapion is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $36M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables across public and private markets—2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, spanning Seed through Series A stages within Defense & Security.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $36M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $90M. Peer-median analysis weights three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $76M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $245M. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity dispersion within the peer set; early-stage defense companies show valuations sensitive to founder pedigree, technical capability, and customer traction visibility. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed revenue or customer metrics for Skapion, reliance on founder background (CEO ex-XTEND, CTO background undisclosed) as a valuation signal, and the nascent market for autonomous defense systems where comparable trading multiples remain unstable.
